plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
<% const budget = 100000; const file = env.RELEASE_TRAIN === "core" ? "CHANGELOG.md" : "CHANGELOG." + env.RELEASE_TRAIN + ".md"; let notes = nextRelease.notes; if (notes.length > budget) { notes = notes.slice(0, notes.lastIndexOf("\n", budget)) + "\n\n…and more: the whole list is in [" + file + "](https://github.com/AdCodicem/AdCodicem.ValueObjects/blob/" + nextRelease.gitTag + "/" + file + ").\n"; } %><%= notes %>
<% const packageIds = (env.RELEASE_PACKAGE_IDS || "").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean); const bundle = env.RELEASE_TRAIN === "core" ? "AdCodicem.ValueObjects" : "AdCodicem.ValueObjects." + env.RELEASE_TRAIN; const sample = env.RELEASE_TRAIN === "core" ? "AdCodicem.ValueObjects.Json" : packageIds[0]; if (packageIds.length) { %>
### NuGet packages

| Package | Version |
| --- | --- |
<% packageIds.forEach(function (id) { %>| `<%= id %>` | [<%= nextRelease.version %>](https://www.nuget.org/packages/<%= id %>/<%= nextRelease.version %>) |
<% }); %>
The `.nupkg` and `.snupkg` files attached to this release carry a signed build provenance attestation (`<%= bundle %>.<%= nextRelease.version %>.sigstore.json`). To check one:

```sh
gh attestation verify <%= packageIds[0] %>.<%= nextRelease.version %>.nupkg --repo AdCodicem/AdCodicem.ValueObjects
```

The assemblies inside the packages are attested too. nuget.org re-signs each `.nupkg`, which changes its digest, but leaves the assemblies as they were packed, so a package restored from nuget.org is checked through one of them:

```sh
gh attestation verify ~/.nuget/packages/<%= sample.toLowerCase() %>/<%= nextRelease.version %>/lib/net10.0/<%= sample %>.dll --repo AdCodicem/AdCodicem.ValueObjects --signer-workflow AdCodicem/AdCodicem.ValueObjects/.github/workflows/release.yml
```
<% } %>
